data.narrative:
Glimpse is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $17M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of nine private peers in the Climate & Energy sector—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—alongside one public comparable (LNZA). However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints to support a robust peer-median valuation method; only the stage-progression method yields a defensible quantitative result.

Applying stage-progression analysis, which anchors on total capital raised as a proxy for enterprise value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yields an implied valuation of $34M. This single-method triangulation produces a range of $29M (low) to $39M (high), centered on the $34M median.

The analysis is constrained by limited peer comparability at the Series A stage within this sector. Conviction in the $29M–$39M range is moderate; material upside or downside would depend on proprietary technology differentiation, revenue traction, and capital efficiency relative to the private peer cohort—none of which are quantified in available data. A peer-median approach remains inaccessible pending deeper same-stage comp disclosure or revenue-based metrics.
